title: Playing with Coridge Davis at Club Bali and in Atlantic City
summary: From late 1944 Phillips played with Coridge Davis at Club Bali on 14th and T in Washington and from June 1945 in Atlantic City.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: You let go of that band in August of '44.
You went to Atlantic City with him, right?
Yeah. But I didn't go to Atlantic City with him until '45.
What did you do in '44 with him?

In '44 I played a club that I went into with him... Around the latter part of the year, I played at Club Bali at 14th and T. During the war-time that was an awfully big club. They had big shows and everything. Everybody came there. Pearl Bailey, Lena Horne. They all came in that club.
How long did you play up there with him?
I stayed up there with him until I left him in... I stayed with him until '46. Not up there, because left there and went to Atlantic City.
When did you go to Atlantic City with him?
Then up in Atlantic City for two years.
